description.sk: Hrubá zemiakovo-vaječná omeleta, výborná teplá aj studená.
description.en: A thick potato and egg omelette, great warm or cold.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, pozdĺžne rozpoľ a nakrájaj na tenké plátky asi 3 mm; cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké pásiky. Plátky zemiakov neumývaj – škrob na nich pomôže tortille držať pokope.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, halve them lengthways and slice them thinly, about 3 mm; slice the onion into thin strips. Do not rinse the potato slices – their starch helps the tortilla hold together.

steps.sk: V nepriľnavej panvici s priemerom asi 24 cm zohrej olej na miernom až strednom ohni. Pridaj zemiaky, cibuľu a polovicu soli, premiešaj, prikry a nechaj 20 minút pomaly dusiť; občas premiešaj a nadvihni spodné plátky. Zemiaky majú byť úplne mäkké, ale nie opečené ani chrumkavé.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan about 24 cm across over medium-low heat. Add the potatoes, onion and half the salt, stir, cover and cook gently for 20 minutes, stirring now and then and lifting the bottom slices. The potatoes should be completely soft but not browned or crisp.

steps.sk: V mise rozšľahaj vajcia so zvyšnou soľou. Zemiaky s cibuľou preber dierovanou lyžicou do vajec (olej nechaj v panvici), premiešaj a nechaj 5 minút odstáť – zemiaky nasajú vajce a tortilla bude krémová.
steps.en: Beat the eggs with the remaining salt in a bowl. Lift the potatoes and onion into the eggs with a slotted spoon (leave the oil in the pan), stir and leave for 5 minutes – the potatoes soak up the egg and the tortilla turns creamy.

steps.sk: Olej z panvice vylej do misky a nechaj v nej len asi lyžicu (zvyšok sa hodí na ďalšie varenie). Panvicu rozohrej na strednom ohni, vlej zmes, zarovnaj ju a 1 minútu panvicou zľahka pretriasaj, aby sa neprilepila. Zníž oheň a peč 6 minút, kým okraje nestuhnú a spodok nie je zlatý.
steps.en: Pour the oil out of the pan into a bowl, leaving about a tablespoon (the rest is good for other cooking). Heat the pan over medium heat, pour in the mixture, level it and shake the pan gently for 1 minute so it does not stick. Lower the heat and cook for 6 minutes until the edges are set and the underside is golden.

steps.sk: Na panvicu polož veľký plochý tanier, pevne ho pridrž a jedným rýchlym pohybom panvicu prevráť – tortilla zostane na tanieri. Opatrne ju zošmykni späť do panvice nestuhnutou stranou nadol a okraje stierkou zastrč dovnútra.
steps.en: Put a large flat plate over the pan, hold it firmly and flip the pan over in one quick movement so the tortilla lands on the plate. Slide it carefully back into the pan, uncooked side down, and tuck the edges in with a spatula.

steps.sk: Dopeč ju na miernom ohni 3 až 4 minúty, kým stred po stlačení nie je pevný, ale ešte jemne pruží. Prelož ju na tanier a pred krájaním nechaj aspoň 5 minút odpočinúť. Chutí teplá aj studená a v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Cook it over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes more until the centre feels firm but still slightly springy when pressed. Slide it onto a plate and rest it for at least 5 minutes before cutting. It is good warm or cold and keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Francúzska omeleta s hubami a syrom
title.en: French omelette with mushrooms and cheese

description.sk: Hodvábna omeleta za desať minút – rýchle raňajky plné bielkovín.
description.en: A silky omelette in ten minutes: a quick protein-packed breakfast.

steps.sk: Šampiňóny očisti a nakrájaj na tenké plátky, syr nastrúhaj a pažítku nakrájaj. Všetko maj pripravené pri sporáku – samotná omeleta je hotová za 2 minúty.
steps.en: Clean and thinly slice the mushrooms, grate the cheese and snip the chives. Have everything ready by the stove – the omelette itself takes 2 minutes.

steps.sk: V nepriľnavej panvici s priemerom asi 20 cm roztop polovicu masla na stredne vysokom ohni a huby opekaj asi 4 minúty, kým nepustia vodu, tá sa neodparí a huby nie sú zlatisté. Prelož ich na tanier a panvicu utri papierovou utierkou.
steps.en: Melt half the butter in a non-stick frying pan about 20 cm across over medium-high heat and cook the mushrooms for about 4 minutes until they release their water, it evaporates and they turn golden. Tip them onto a plate and wipe out the pan with kitchen paper.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj vidličkou so soľou a korením asi 30 sekúnd, kým sa bielky úplne nespoja so žĺtkami a zmes nie je jednoliata.
steps.en: Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper using a fork for about 30 seconds until the whites and yolks are fully combined and even.

steps.sk: Panvicu daj na stredný oheň a roztop v nej zvyšné maslo, kým sa nespení. Vlej vajcia a stierkou ich neustále pomaly posúvaj od okrajov do stredu; panvicou krúž, aby tekuté vajce zatieklo na voľné miesta. Asi po 2 minútach je omeleta takmer stuhnutá, ale navrchu ešte krémová – vtedy ju stiahni z ohňa.
steps.en: Put the pan over medium heat and melt the remaining butter until it foams. Pour in the eggs and keep slowly pushing them from the edges to the centre with a spatula, tilting the pan so the runny egg fills the gaps. After about 2 minutes the omelette is almost set but still creamy on top – take it off the heat then.

steps.sk: Na jednu polovicu daj huby a syr, druhú polovicu stierkou preklop a omeletu nechaj zošmyknúť na teplý tanier – zvyškové teplo syr roztopí. Posyp pažítkou a jedz hneď.
steps.en: Put the mushrooms and cheese on one half, fold the other half over with the spatula and slide the omelette onto a warm plate – the residual heat melts the cheese. Sprinkle with the chives and eat at once.

description.sk: Teplé jablká pod chrumkavou maslovou posýpkou.
description.en: Warm apples under a crunchy buttery topping.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C (horný a spodný ohrev). Maslo nakrájaj na malé kocky a daj ho späť do chladničky – posýpka sa robí zo studeného masla, inak by bola mazľavá.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (conventional). Cut the butter into small cubes and put it back in the fridge – the topping needs cold butter or it turns pasty.

steps.sk: Jablká ošúp, zbav jadrovníkov a nakrájaj na kúsky asi 2 cm. V zapekacej mise (asi 20 × 20 cm) ich premiešaj s citrónovou šťavou, polovicou škorice a lyžicou cukru. Kyslejšie jablká držia tvar lepšie a chuť je výraznejšia.
steps.en: Peel and core the apples and cut them into roughly 2 cm pieces. Toss them in a baking dish (about 20 × 20 cm) with the lemon juice, half the cinnamon and a spoonful of the sugar. Tart apples hold their shape better and taste brighter.

steps.sk: V mise zmiešaj múku, vločky, zvyšný cukor a škoricu. Pridaj studené maslo a končekmi prstov ho rozdrv s múkou, kým nevznikne hrudkovitá posýpka s kúskami veľkosti hrášku. Nevypracuj z nej cesto – má zostať sypká.
steps.en: Mix the flour, oats, remaining sugar and cinnamon in a bowl. Add the cold butter and rub it into the flour with your fingertips until you have a lumpy crumble with pea-sized pieces. Do not knead it into a dough – it should stay loose.

steps.sk: Posýpku rovnomerne rozsyp na jablká a nepritláčaj ju. Peč 35 minút, kým povrch nie je zlatohnedý a na okrajoch nebublá jablková šťava.
steps.en: Scatter the crumble evenly over the apples without pressing it down. Bake for 35 minutes until the top is golden brown and the apple juices bubble at the edges.

steps.sk: Nechaj crumble 5 až 10 minút vychladnúť, aby šťava zhustla. Podávaj teplý, napríklad s bielym jogurtom. Zvyšok vydrží v chladničke 3 dni a dá sa zohriať v rúre.
steps.en: Let the crumble cool for 5 to 10 minutes so the juices thicken. Serve warm, for example with plain yoghurt. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 3 days and reheat in the oven.

description.sk: Hustý paprikový guláš so zemiakmi – ešte lepší na druhý deň.
description.en: A thick paprika goulash with potatoes, even better the next day.

steps.sk: Mäso osuš a nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm, hrubé šľachy odstráň. Cibule nakrájaj nadrobno – na guláš sa jej dáva veľa a rozvarí sa do omáčky.
steps.en: Pat the beef dry and cut it into roughly 3 cm cubes, trimming off any thick sinew. Finely chop the onions – goulash uses a lot and they melt into the sauce.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci s hrubým dnom rozohrej masť na strednom ohni a cibuľu pomaly opekaj asi 12 minút do zlatohneda; často miešaj, aby sa nepripálila. Dobre opečená cibuľa je základ chuti aj hustoty gulášu.
steps.en: Heat the lard in a large heavy-based pan over medium heat and cook the onions slowly for about 12 minutes until golden brown, stirring often so they do not burn. Well-browned onions give goulash both its flavour and its body.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso, zvýš oheň a opekaj ho asi 5 minút, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zatiahnuté a nepustí šťavu.
steps.en: Add the beef, turn up the heat and cook for about 5 minutes until it is sealed on all sides and releases its juices.

steps.sk: Hrniec stiahni z ohňa a vmiešaj papriku, rascu a pretlak – na ohni by paprika zhorkla. Hneď zalej 1 l vody, osoľ a priveď do varu. Prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a nechaj 60 minút pomaly dusiť; občas premiešaj a ak treba, podlej vodou.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat and stir in the paprika, caraway and tomato paste – over the heat the paprika turns bitter. Immediately pour in 1 litre of water, add the salt and bring to the boil. Cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and simmer gently for 60 minutes, stirring now and then and adding water if needed.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm, papriku zbav semienok a nakrájaj na kúsky. Pridaj ich do gulášu, prilej toľko vody, aby boli zakryté, a var ďalších 25 minút.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and cut them into roughly 2 cm cubes; seed the pepper and cut it into pieces. Add them to the goulash with enough water to cover and simmer for another 25 minutes.

steps.sk: Guláš je hotový, keď sa mäso dá ľahko rozdeliť vidličkou a zemiaky sú mäkké; ak je mäso ešte tuhé, var ďalších 10 až 15 minút. Nakoniec vmiešaj prelisovaný cesnak, majorán a korenie a nechaj 5 minút postáť.
steps.en: The goulash is ready when the beef breaks apart easily with a fork and the potatoes are tender; if the meat is still tough, simmer for 10 to 15 minutes more. Finally stir in the crushed garlic, marjoram and pepper and let it stand for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Podávaj s chlebom. Guláš je na druhý deň ešte lepší; v chladničke vydrží 4 dni a v mrazničke 3 mesiace (zemiaky po rozmrazení trochu zmäknú).
steps.en: Serve with bread. Goulash is even better the next day; it keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer (the potatoes soften a little after thawing).

title.sk: Paella s kuracím mäsom a krevetami

description.sk: Šafránovo žltá ryža z jednej panvice, s údenou paprikou.
description.en: Golden one-pan rice with smoked paprika.

steps.sk: Bujóny rozpusti v 900 ml horúcej vody. Kuracie stehná nakrájaj na kúsky asi 3 cm, cibuľu nadrobno, papriku na pásiky a cesnak nasekaj. Ryžu neumývaj – jej škrob pomôže vytvoriť krémovú vrstvu.
steps.en: Dissolve the stock cubes in 900 ml of hot water. Cut the chicken thighs into roughly 3 cm pieces, finely chop the onion, slice the pepper into strips and chop the garlic. Do not rinse the rice – its starch makes a creamy layer.

steps.sk: V čo najširšej panvici (ideálne 30 cm a viac) zohrej olej na stredne vysokom ohni a kuracie kúsky opekaj asi 6 minút, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán zlaté. Pridaj cibuľu, papriku a cesnak a opekaj 4 minúty, kým nezmäknú.
steps.en: Heat the oil in the widest frying pan you have (ideally 30 cm or more) over medium-high heat and brown the chicken pieces for about 6 minutes until golden on all sides. Add the onion, pepper and garlic and cook for 4 minutes until softened.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj údenú papriku, kurkumu a paradajky a minútu var, kým paradajky nezhustnú. Potom vsyp ryžu a minútu ju miešaj, aby sa obalila v oleji a korení.
steps.en: Stir in the smoked paprika, turmeric and tomatoes and cook for a minute until the tomatoes thicken. Then add the rice and stir for a minute to coat it in the oil and spices.

steps.sk: Zalej horúcim vývarom, premiešaj, ryžu rovnomerne rozprestri po celej panvici a odteraz už nemiešaj – na dne sa má vytvoriť opečená kôrka (socarrat). Var na strednom až miernom ohni 15 minút.
steps.en: Pour in the hot stock, stir, spread the rice evenly across the pan and from now on do not stir – a toasted crust (socarrat) should form on the bottom. Simmer over medium-low heat for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Krevety a hrášok poukladaj navrch a zľahka ich zatlač do ryže. Var ešte 5 až 7 minút, kým krevety nie sú ružové a nepriehľadné a ryža nevsiakne tekutinu a nie je mäkká. Na konci počuť jemné praskanie – to sa tvorí kôrka; keď zavonia opečeno, odstav.
steps.en: Arrange the prawns and peas on top and press them lightly into the rice. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes more until the prawns are pink and opaque and the rice has absorbed the liquid and is tender. At the end you hear a gentle crackling – that is the crust forming; once it smells toasty, take it off the heat.

steps.sk: Panvicu prikry čistou utierkou a nechaj 5 minút odpočinúť, aby ryža dotiahla. Podávaj priamo z panvice s mesiačikmi citróna.
steps.en: Cover the pan with a clean tea towel and let it rest for 5 minutes so the rice finishes cooking. Serve straight from the pan with lemon wedges.

description.sk: Studená španielska zeleninová polievka na horúce dni.
description.en: A chilled Spanish vegetable soup for hot days.

steps.sk: Paradajky umy, vykroj stopky a nahrubo nakrájaj. Uhorku ošúp, papriku zbav semienok a obe nahrubo nakrájaj; malý kúsok uhorky si odlož na ozdobu. Cibuľu a cesnak ošúp.
steps.en: Wash the tomatoes, cut out the stems and chop them roughly. Peel the cucumber, seed the pepper and chop both roughly, keeping a small piece of cucumber for garnish. Peel the onion and garlic.

steps.sk: Krajec chleba zbav kôrky, natrhaj ho a na minútu namoč do studenej vody, potom ho jemne vytlač. Chlieb polievku zahustí a dodá jej zamatovú textúru.
steps.en: Cut the crust off the bread, tear it up and soak it in cold water for a minute, then squeeze it gently. The bread thickens the soup and gives it a velvety texture.

steps.sk: Do mixéra daj zeleninu, chlieb, olej, ocot a soľ a mixuj 1 až 2 minúty, kým polievka nie je úplne hladká. Ak sa všetko nezmestí, mixuj vo dvoch dávkach. Pre jemnejší výsledok ju môžeš pretlačiť cez sitko.
steps.en: Put the vegetables, bread, oil, vinegar and salt in the blender and blend for 1 to 2 minutes until completely smooth. If it does not all fit, blend in two batches. For a finer result, push it through a sieve.

steps.sk: Ochutnaj a dochuť – studené jedlá potrebujú výraznejšiu chuť, preto gazpacho znesie aj kvapku octu navyše. Má byť dobre vychladené: ak paradajky neboli z chladničky, daj ho aspoň na hodinu vychladiť alebo pridaj pár kociek ľadu.
steps.en: Taste and adjust – cold dishes need bolder seasoning, so gazpacho can take an extra drop of vinegar. It should be well chilled: if the tomatoes were not from the fridge, chill it for at least an hour or add a few ice cubes.

steps.sk: Podávaj v miskách alebo pohároch, posypané kockami odloženej uhorky a pokvapkané olejom. V uzavretej nádobe vydrží v chladničke 3 dni; pred podávaním ho premiešaj.
steps.en: Serve in bowls or glasses, topped with the reserved cucumber, diced, and a drizzle of oil. In a closed container it keeps in the fridge for 3 days; stir before serving.

description.sk: Provensálska dusená zelenina s tymianom, výborná aj studená.
description.en: Provençal stewed vegetables with thyme, also lovely cold.

steps.sk: Baklažán, cukety a papriky (bez semienok) nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm – rovnako veľké zmäknú naraz. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a cesnak nasekaj.
steps.en: Cut the aubergine, courgettes and peppers (seeded) into roughly 2 cm cubes – pieces of the same size soften together. Finely chop the onion and chop the garlic.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci alebo hlbokej panvici zohrej 2 lyžice oleja na stredne vysokom ohni a baklažán opekaj asi 6 minút, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zlatistý. Najprv nasaje všetok olej, ale po chvíli ho začne púšťať – ďalší nepridávaj. Odlož ho na tanier.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a wide pan or deep frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the aubergine for about 6 minutes until golden on all sides. It soaks up all the oil at first but releases it again after a while – do not add more. Set it aside on a plate.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji opekaj cukety s paprikami 5 minút, kým sa nezačnú farbiť. Keď zeleninu opečieš zvlášť, každá si zachová svoju chuť a štruktúru.
steps.en: Cook the courgettes and peppers in the remaining oil for 5 minutes until they start to colour. Browning the vegetables separately keeps each one's flavour and texture.

steps.sk: Pridaj cibuľu a cesnak a opekaj 2 minúty. Potom vmiešaj paradajky, tymian, baklažán, soľ a korenie a priveď do varu.
steps.en: Add the onion and garlic and cook for 2 minutes. Then stir in the tomatoes, thyme, aubergine, salt and pepper and bring to the boil.

steps.sk: Prikry a nechaj dusiť na miernom ohni 30 minút, občas opatrne premiešaj. Zelenina má byť mäkká, ale nie rozvarená na kašu, a omáčka hustá; ak je riedka, posledných 5 minút var odokryté.
steps.en: Cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring gently now and then. The vegetables should be soft but not mushy and the sauce thick; if it is thin, cook uncovered for the last 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Posyp natrhanou bazalkou a podávaj teplé alebo vlažné, s chlebom. Ratatouille je na druhý deň ešte lepšie; v chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Scatter over torn basil and serve warm or lukewarm with bread. Ratatouille is even better the next day; it keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title.sk: Pečená treska v strúhanke s hranolkami

description.sk: Chrumkavá ryba aj hranolky z rúry, bez fritézy.
description.en: Crispy fish and chips from the oven, no deep fryer.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C (horný a spodný ohrev). Zemiaky umy a nakrájaj na hrubé hranolky asi 1,5 cm. Opláchni ich studenou vodou a dôkladne osuš utierkou – suché sa upečú dochrumkava.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (conventional). Scrub the potatoes and cut them into thick chips about 1.5 cm. Rinse them in cold water and dry them thoroughly with a tea towel – dry chips bake up crisp.

steps.sk: Na plechu vystlanom papierom premiešaj hranolky s 2 lyžicami oleja a polovicou soli a rozlož ich v jednej vrstve s medzerami. Peč 20 minút.
steps.en: On a lined baking tray toss the chips with 2 tablespoons of the oil and half the salt and spread them in a single layer with gaps. Bake for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Medzitým rybu osuš papierovou utierkou, rozdeľ na 2 porcie, osoľ zvyšnou soľou a okoreň. Strúhanku premiešaj so zvyšným olejom, aby sa v rúre opiekla dozlatista. Priprav si tri misky: s múkou, s rozšľahaným vajcom a so strúhankou.
steps.en: Meanwhile pat the fish dry with kitchen paper, cut it into 2 portions and season with the remaining salt and the pepper. Mix the breadcrumbs with the rest of the oil so they turn golden in the oven. Set out three dishes: flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.

steps.sk: Rybu obaľ v múke a otrep prebytok, ponor do vajca a nakoniec obaľ v strúhanke, ktorú pritlač dlaňou. Mrazenú tresku najprv úplne rozmraz a dobre osuš, inak obal odpadne.
steps.en: Coat the fish in flour and shake off the excess, dip it in the egg and finally press it into the breadcrumbs. Thaw frozen cod completely and dry it well first, or the coating falls off.

steps.sk: Hranolky obráť a odsuň k okrajom a rybu polož na voľné miesto na plechu. Peč 12 až 15 minút, kým obal nie je zlatistý a ryba v najhrubšom mieste nepriehľadná a ľahko sa rozdeľuje na lupienky (63 °C).
steps.en: Turn the chips, push them to the sides and lay the fish in the space on the tray. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the coating is golden and the fish is opaque and flakes easily at its thickest point (63 °C).

steps.sk: Hrášok zalej vriacou vodou, nechaj 3 minúty postáť a sceď. Podávaj rybu s hranolkami, hráškom a mesiačikmi citróna na pokvapkanie.
steps.en: Cover the peas with boiling water, leave for 3 minutes and drain. Serve the fish with the chips, peas and lemon wedges for squeezing.

description.sk: Nadýchaná trhaná palacinka s hrozienkami a lekvárom.
description.en: A fluffy torn pancake with raisins and plum jam.

steps.sk: Ak používaš hrozienka, namoč ich na 10 minút do teplej vody, aby napučali, a potom ich sceď. Vajcia rozdeľ na žĺtky a bielky – do bielkov sa nesmie dostať ani kvapka žĺtka, inak sa nevyšľahajú.
steps.en: If using raisins, soak them in warm water for 10 minutes to plump them up, then drain. Separate the eggs – not a drop of yolk may get into the whites or they will not whip.

steps.sk: Žĺtky vyšľahaj metličkou s mliekom, múkou a soľou na hladké husté cesto bez hrudiek.
steps.en: Whisk the yolks with the milk, flour and salt into a smooth, thick batter with no lumps.

steps.sk: Bielky v čistej mise vyšľahaj do peny, postupne pridávaj cukor a šľahaj na tuhý lesklý sneh – keď misu otočíš, sneh z nej nevypadne. Stierkou ho v dvoch dávkach zľahka vmiešaj do cesta, len kým nezmiznú biele pruhy; prudkým miešaním by cesto spľasklo.
steps.en: Whisk the whites in a clean bowl until foamy, then gradually add the sugar and whisk to stiff, glossy peaks – they stay put if you turn the bowl over. Fold them gently into the batter with a spatula in two additions, just until no white streaks remain; vigorous stirring knocks the air out.

steps.sk: Na veľkej nepriľnavej panvici rozpusti polovicu masla na miernom až strednom ohni. Vlej cesto, zarovnaj ho, posyp hrozienkami a peč 5 minút, kým spodok nie je zlatohnedý a cesto navrchu nezačne tuhnúť. Nadvihni okraj a skontroluj farbu.
steps.en: Melt half the butter in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-low heat. Pour in the batter, level it, scatter over the raisins and cook for 5 minutes until the underside is golden brown and the top starts to set. Lift an edge to check the colour.

steps.sk: Cesto obracačkou rozdeľ na štvrtiny a každú obráť. Pod ne pridaj zvyšné maslo a peč ďalšie 3 minúty.
steps.en: Cut the pancake into quarters with the spatula and turn each one. Add the remaining butter underneath and cook for 3 minutes more.

steps.sk: Potom ho dvoma vidličkami roztrhaj na nepravidelné kúsky veľkosti sústa a za stáleho obracania ich opekaj ešte 1 až 2 minúty, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán zlatisté a vnútri prepečené, nie tekuté.
steps.en: Then tear it into rough bite-sized pieces with two forks and toss them in the pan for 1 to 2 minutes more until golden all over and cooked through, not runny inside.

steps.sk: Posyp práškovým cukrom a podávaj hneď s lekvárom.
steps.en: Dust with icing sugar and serve at once with the plum jam.

title.sk: Nemecký zemiakový šalát s octom a cibuľou
title.en: German potato salad with vinegar and onion

description.sk: Ľahký šalát bez majonézy, zaliaty teplým vývarom s octom.
description.en: A light salad without mayonnaise, dressed with warm broth and vinegar.

steps.sk: Zemiaky (najlepšie pevné, šalátové) umy, vlož ich v šupke do hrnca, zalej studenou vodou a priveď do varu. Var asi 25 minút domäkka – nôž má do nich vojsť ľahko, ale nesmú sa rozpadať.
steps.en: Scrub the potatoes (ideally a waxy salad variety), put them unpeeled in a pan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Cook for about 25 minutes until tender – a knife should slide in easily but they must not fall apart.

steps.sk: Medzitým cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno. Bujón rozpusti v 200 ml horúcej vody, pridaj cibuľu, ocot, horčicu a cukor, priveď do varu a var 1 minútu, aby cibuľa trochu zmäkla.
steps.en: Meanwhile finely chop the onion. Dissolve the stock cube in 200 ml of hot water, add the onion, vinegar, mustard and sugar, bring to the boil and simmer for 1 minute to soften the onion a little.

steps.sk: Zemiaky sceď, nechaj ich chvíľu vychladnúť, kým ich udržíš, a ešte teplé ošúp – napichni ich na vidličku a šupku stiahni nožom. Nakrájaj ich na tenké plátky asi 3 mm do misy.
steps.en: Drain the potatoes, let them cool just until you can handle them and peel them while warm – spear each on a fork and pull off the skin with a knife. Slice them thinly, about 3 mm, into a bowl.

steps.sk: Horúci nálev hneď vylej na teplé zemiaky a opatrne premiešaj. Nechaj 15 minút nasiaknuť – teplé zemiaky nasajú nálev až do stredu a šalát bude šťavnatý, nie suchý.
steps.en: Pour the hot dressing over the warm potatoes straight away and mix gently. Leave for 15 minutes to soak – warm potatoes absorb it right to the centre, so the salad is juicy rather than dry.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj olej, korenie a nakrájanú pažítku. Ochutnaj – šalát má byť jemne kyslý; ak zemiaky nasali všetok nálev, pridaj lyžicu horúcej vody. Podávaj vlažný alebo studený, napríklad k rezňom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Stir in the oil, pepper and snipped chives. Taste – the salad should be gently tangy; if the potatoes have soaked up all the dressing, add a spoonful of hot water. Serve lukewarm or cold, for example with schnitzel. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Krehký koláč s vaječno-smotanovou plnkou a slaninou.
description.en: A crisp pastry case with a creamy egg and bacon filling.

steps.sk: Studené maslo nakrájaj na malé kocky a v mise ho s múkou a štipkou soli rozdrob končekmi prstov na drobnú posýpku. Pridaj 1 vajce a 2 lyžice studenej vody a rýchlo spracuj na hladké cesto. Dlho ho nemies – teplom rúk by maslo zmäklo a cesto by bolo tuhé.
steps.en: Cut the cold butter into small cubes and rub it into the flour with a pinch of the salt using your fingertips until it looks like fine crumbs. Add 1 egg and 2 tablespoons of cold water and quickly bring it together into a smooth dough. Do not knead for long – warm hands soften the butter and make the pastry tough.

steps.sk: Cesto stlač do placky, zabaľ do fólie a daj na 20 minút do chladničky, aby stuhlo a dalo sa vaľkať.
steps.en: Press the dough into a disc, wrap it in cling film and chill for 20 minutes so it firms up and rolls easily.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C (horný a spodný ohrev). Cesto rozvaľkaj na pomúčenej doske na kruh hrubý asi 3 mm a vylož ním formu na koláč s priemerom asi 24 cm; okraje vytiahni až po vrch. Dno popichaj vidličkou, aby sa nenafúklo.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (conventional). Roll out the pastry on a floured board into a circle about 3 mm thick and line a tart tin about 24 cm across, pressing it up to the rim. Prick the base with a fork so it does not puff up.

steps.sk: Korpus peč naprázdno 12 minút, kým nezačne svetlo zlatnúť. Vďaka predpečeniu zostane dno chrumkavé a od plnky nerozmokne.
steps.en: Blind-bake the case for 12 minutes until it starts to turn pale golden. Pre-baking keeps the base crisp so the filling does not make it soggy.

steps.sk: Medzitým slaninu nakrájaj na prúžky a opeč ju na suchej panvici asi 5 minút do chrumkava; nechaj ju odkvapkať na papierovej utierke. Syr nastrúhaj. Zvyšné 3 vajcia vyšľahaj so smotanou, mliekom, muškátovým orieškom, zvyšnou soľou a korením.
steps.en: Meanwhile cut the bacon into strips and fry it in a dry pan for about 5 minutes until crisp; drain it on kitchen paper. Grate the cheese. Whisk the remaining 3 eggs with the cream, milk, nutmeg, remaining salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Teplotu zníž na 180 °C. Na predpečený korpus rovnomerne rozsyp slaninu a syr a pomaly zalej vajíčkovou zmesou. Peč 30 minút, kým plnka nie je zlatistá a v strede stuhnutá – pri jemnom potrasení formou sa stred už nevlní.
steps.en: Lower the oven to 180 °C. Scatter the bacon and cheese evenly over the pre-baked case and slowly pour in the egg mixture. Bake for 30 minutes until the filling is golden and set in the centre – it no longer wobbles when you gently shake the tin.

steps.sk: Quiche nechaj aspoň 10 minút vychladnúť, aby sa plnka spevnila, a potom krájaj. Chutí teplý aj studený; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Let the quiche cool for at least 10 minutes so the filling firms up before slicing. It is good warm or cold and keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Francúzsky poulet à la moutarde: krémová omáčka s dijonskou horčicou.
description.en: French poulet à la moutarde: a creamy Dijon mustard sauce.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, väčšie rozpoľ a vlož do hrnca so studenou osolenou vodou. Priveď do varu a var asi 20 minút domäkka, potom ich sceď a nechaj prikryté v teple.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, halve the larger ones and put them in a pan of cold salted water. Bring to the boil and cook for about 20 minutes until tender, then drain and keep warm, covered.

steps.sk: Medzitým stehná osuš papierovou utierkou a z oboch strán ich osoľ a okoreň. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a cesnak nasekaj.
steps.en: Meanwhile pat the thighs dry with kitchen paper and season both sides with the salt and pepper. Finely chop the onion and the garlic.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici roztop maslo na stredne vysokom ohni. Stehná polož kožou (alebo hladkou stranou) nadol a 6 minút ich opekaj bez hýbania, kým nie sú zlatohnedé. Obráť ich, opeč ešte 4 minúty a prelož na tanier – vnútri ešte nemusia byť prepečené.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat. Lay the thighs skin side (or smooth side) down and cook for 6 minutes without moving them until golden brown. Turn them, cook for 4 minutes more and move them to a plate – they do not need to be cooked through yet.

steps.sk: Do výpeku pridaj cibuľu a opekaj ju 3 minúty, kým nezmäkne, potom pridaj cesnak. Prilej víno (alebo 100 ml vody) a varechou vyškrab opečené zvyšky z dna – sú plné chuti. Var asi 2 minúty, kým sa tekutina neodparí na polovicu.
steps.en: Add the onion to the pan juices and cook for 3 minutes until soft, then add the garlic. Pour in the wine (or 100 ml of water) and scrape up the browned bits from the bottom with a wooden spoon – they are full of flavour. Simmer for about 2 minutes until reduced by half.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj smotanu, horčicu a tymian a vráť do panvice mäso aj so šťavou z taniera. Prikry a mierne var 12 minút, kým kura nie je vnútri prepečené (75 °C) a omáčka nezhustne. Ak je riedka, posledné 2 minúty var odokryté.
steps.en: Stir in the cream, mustard and thyme and return the chicken to the pan with any juices from the plate. Cover and simmer gently for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through (75 °C) and the sauce has thickened. If it is thin, simmer uncovered for the last 2 minutes.

steps.sk: Ochutnaj omáčku a podľa chuti pridaj trochu horčice. Podávaj stehná so zemiakmi a štedrou dávkou omáčky.
steps.en: Taste the sauce and add a little more mustard if you like. Serve the thighs with the potatoes and plenty of sauce.

title.sk: Francúzska cibuľová polievka so syrovou hrenkou
title.en: French onion soup with cheese toast

description.sk: Sladká karamelizovaná cibuľa, vývar a gratinovaný chlieb.
description.en: Sweet caramelised onions, broth and a gratinated cheese toast.

steps.sk: Cibule ošúp, rozpoľ a nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska asi 3 mm. Je jej veľa, ale pri karamelizácii sa zmenší na štvrtinu.
steps.en: Peel and halve the onions and slice them into thin half-moons, about 3 mm. It looks like a lot, but they shrink to a quarter as they caramelise.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci s hrubým dnom roztop maslo na strednom ohni, pridaj cibuľu a premiešaj. Prvých 10 minút ju nechaj pod pokrievkou, aby zmäkla a pustila šťavu.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a large heavy-based pan over medium heat, add the onions and stir. Keep them covered for the first 10 minutes so they soften and release their juices.

steps.sk: Potom odkry, zníž oheň na mierny a cibuľu pomaly karamelizuj ďalších 30 minút; každých pár minút premiešaj a vyškrab dno. Má byť tmavozlatá až gaštanová, sladká a mäkká ako džem. Ak sa začne pripaľovať, prilej lyžicu vody.
steps.en: Then uncover, turn the heat to low and caramelise the onions slowly for another 30 minutes, stirring and scraping the bottom every few minutes. They should be deep golden to chestnut brown, sweet and soft as jam. If they start to catch, add a spoonful of water.

steps.sk: Cibuľu posyp múkou a minútu miešaj. Prilej víno a vyškrab všetko z dna, potom zalej 1,2 l horúcej vody s rozpustenými bujónmi. Pridaj tymian a bobkový list a mierne var 20 minút. Bobkový list vyber a polievku okoreň.
steps.en: Sprinkle the onions with the flour and stir for a minute. Pour in the wine and scrape everything off the bottom, then add 1.2 litres of hot water with the stock cubes dissolved in it. Add the thyme and bay leaf and simmer gently for 20 minutes. Remove the bay leaf and season with the pepper.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na gril s teplotou 220 °C. Krajce chleba opeč v hriankovači alebo na suchej panvici a syr nastrúhaj. Polievku rozdeľ do misiek vhodných do rúry a postav ich na plech.
steps.en: Heat the oven grill to 220 °C. Toast the bread slices in a toaster or dry pan and grate the cheese. Ladle the soup into ovenproof bowls and stand them on a baking tray.

steps.sk: Na každú misku polož hrenku, hrubo ju posyp syrom a zapekaj pod grilom asi 5 minút, kým syr nebublá a nemá zlatohnedé škvrny. Misky sú veľmi horúce – podávaj ich na tanieri.
steps.en: Put a slice of toast on each bowl, cover it thickly with cheese and grill for about 5 minutes until the cheese bubbles and has golden brown patches. The bowls are very hot – serve them on plates.

description.sk: Sýty šalát s tuniakom, vajíčkom, zemiakmi a fazuľkou.
description.en: A filling salad with tuna, egg, potatoes and green beans.

steps.sk: Zemiaky (najlepšie malé a pevné) umy, väčšie rozpoľ a vlož do hrnca so studenou vodou. Priveď do varu a var 11 minút. Medzitým fazuľke odstráň stopky a prekroj ju na polovicu.
steps.en: Scrub the potatoes (ideally small waxy ones), halve the larger ones and put them in a pan of cold water. Bring to the boil and cook for 11 minutes. Meanwhile trim the green beans and cut them in half.

steps.sk: Do hrnca so zemiakmi pridaj fazuľku a var spolu ešte 4 minúty, kým zemiaky nie sú mäkké a fazuľka jasne zelená a jemne chrumkavá. Sceď a prepláchni studenou vodou, aby si fazuľka zachovala farbu.
steps.en: Add the beans to the potatoes and cook together for another 4 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the beans bright green and still crisp. Drain and rinse under cold water so the beans keep their colour.

steps.sk: Súčasne v malom hrnci priveď do varu vodu, lyžicou do nej opatrne vlož vajcia a var 8 minút – žĺtok bude stuhnutý, ale v strede ešte krémový. Prelož ich do studenej vody a ošúp.
steps.en: At the same time bring a small pan of water to the boil, lower in the eggs with a spoon and cook for 8 minutes – the yolks will be set but still creamy in the middle. Transfer them to cold water and peel.

steps.sk: Dresing: v pohári vyšľahaj olej s octom, horčicou a soľou. Zemiaky nakrájaj na štvrtiny, paradajky rozpoľ, cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké krúžky a tuniak sceď a rozober na väčšie kúsky.
steps.en: Dressing: whisk the oil with the vinegar, mustard and salt in a jar. Quarter the potatoes, halve the tomatoes, slice the onion into thin rings and drain the tuna, breaking it into large flakes.

steps.sk: Na veľký tanier alebo do misiek rozlož šalát, na neň zemiaky, fazuľku, paradajky, cibuľu a olivy a navrch tuniak a rozpolené vajcia. Pokvapkaj dresingom a podávaj. Na meal prep ulož šalát do krabičky a dresing a vajcia daj zvlášť; vydrží 2 dni.
steps.en: Arrange the lettuce on a large plate or in bowls with the potatoes, beans, tomatoes, onion and olives on top, then the tuna and halved eggs. Drizzle with the dressing and serve. For meal prep, pack the salad in a container with the dressing and eggs on the side; it keeps for 2 days.

description.sk: Chrumkavé pečené zemiaky s paradajkovou omáčkou a cesnakovým dipom.
description.en: Crispy roast potatoes with a spicy tomato sauce and garlic dip.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C (horný a spodný ohrev). Zemiaky umy a neošúpané nakrájaj na kocky asi 2,5 cm. Osuš ich utierkou a na plechu ich premiešaj s 2 lyžicami oleja, polovicou soli a polovicou údenej papriky. Rozlož ich v jednej vrstve s medzerami.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (conventional). Scrub the potatoes and cut them unpeeled into roughly 2.5 cm cubes. Dry them with a tea towel and toss them on a baking tray with 2 tablespoons of the oil, half the salt and half the smoked paprika. Spread them in a single layer with gaps.

steps.sk: Peč 20 minút, potom zemiaky obracačkou obráť.
steps.en: Roast for 20 minutes, then turn the potatoes with a spatula.

steps.sk: Peč ďalších 15 až 20 minút, kým nie sú zlatohnedé, na hranách chrumkavé a vnútri mäkké. Medzitým 1 strúčik cesnaku nasekaj a v malom hrnci ho na zvyšnom oleji na miernom ohni opekaj pol minúty. Pridaj zvyšnú údenú papriku a čili a hneď aj paradajky, aby korenie nezhorklo.
steps.en: Roast for another 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown, crisp at the edges and soft inside. Meanwhile chop 1 garlic clove and cook it in the remaining oil in a small pan over low heat for half a minute. Add the rest of the smoked paprika and the chilli, then immediately the tomatoes so the spices do not turn bitter.

steps.sk: Omáčku osoľ zvyšnou soľou a var 10 minút, kým nezhustne, potom ju rozmixuj ponorným mixérom dohladka. Ochutnaj – má byť výrazne pikantná a dymová.
steps.en: Season the sauce with the remaining salt and simmer for 10 minutes until thick, then blend it smooth with a stick blender. Taste – it should be distinctly spicy and smoky.

steps.sk: Druhý strúčik cesnaku pretlač a vmiešaj do majonézy. Horúce zemiaky prelož na tanier, polej pikantnou omáčkou a navrch pridaj cesnakovú majonézu, alebo ju podávaj zvlášť na namáčanie.
steps.en: Crush the second garlic clove and stir it into the mayonnaise. Pile the hot potatoes onto a plate, spoon over the spicy sauce and top with the garlic mayonnaise, or serve it on the side for dipping.

title.sk: Cícer so špenátom na španielsky spôsob

description.sk: Garbanzos con espinacas: rastlinné tapas s údenou paprikou a opečeným chlebom.
description.en: Garbanzos con espinacas: plant-based tapas with smoked paprika and fried bread.

steps.sk: Chlieb nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm a cesnak ošúp a nakrájaj na plátky. Cícer sceď a prepláchni. Čerstvý špenát umy a odstráň hrubé stonky; mrazený nechaj rozmraziť a vytlač z neho vodu.
steps.en: Cut the bread into roughly 2 cm cubes and peel and slice the garlic. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Wash fresh spinach and remove the thick stalks; thaw frozen spinach and squeeze out the water.

steps.sk: V hlbokej panvici zohrej 2 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni a chlieb s cesnakom opekaj 3 až 4 minúty, kým nie sú zlatisté a chrumkavé. Cesnak nesmie zhnednúť do tmava, zhorkol by.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat and fry the bread and garlic for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and crisp. Do not let the garlic turn dark brown or it will taste bitter.

steps.sk: Chlieb s cesnakom preber do mažiara alebo misky, pridaj ocot, údenú papriku a 2 lyžice vody a roztlač alebo rozmixuj na hrubú pastu. Tá omáčku zahustí a dodá jej typickú chuť.
steps.en: Tip the bread and garlic into a mortar or bowl, add the vinegar, smoked paprika and 2 tablespoons of water and pound or blend into a coarse paste. It thickens the sauce and gives the dish its typical flavour.

steps.sk: Do panvice daj zvyšný olej a rímsky kmín, po pár sekundách pridaj špenát a miešaj 2 až 3 minúty, kým nezvädne. Čerstvý špenát pridávaj po hrstiach – zmenší sa na zlomok objemu.
steps.en: Add the remaining oil and the cumin to the pan, after a few seconds add the spinach and stir for 2 to 3 minutes until wilted. Add fresh spinach a handful at a time – it shrinks to a fraction of its volume.

steps.sk: Pridaj cícer, chlebovú pastu, soľ a 150 ml vody, premiešaj a var 8 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne a neobalí cícer. Ochutnaj, podľa chuti pridaj kvapku octu a podávaj s chlebom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Add the chickpeas, bread paste, salt and 150 ml of water, stir and simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the chickpeas. Taste, add a drop more vinegar if you like and serve with bread. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Kura s chorizom a fazuľou z jedného hrnca
title.en: One-pot chicken with chorizo and beans

description.sk: Dymové kura s fazuľou a paradajkami – málo riadu, veľa chuti.
description.en: Smoky chicken with beans and tomatoes: few dishes, lots of flavour.

steps.sk: Kuracie stehná osuš a nakrájaj na kusy asi 4 cm, chorizo na kolieska hrubé 5 mm, cibuľu a papriku na kúsky a cesnak nasekaj. Fazuľu sceď a prepláchni.
steps.en: Pat the chicken thighs dry and cut them into roughly 4 cm pieces, slice the chorizo 5 mm thick, cut the onion and pepper into pieces and chop the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a chorizo opekaj 2 až 3 minúty, kým nepustí červený tuk. Pridaj mäso a opekaj ho asi 5 minút, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zlaté.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and fry the chorizo for 2 to 3 minutes until it releases its red fat. Add the chicken and brown it for about 5 minutes until golden on all sides.

steps.sk: Pridaj cibuľu, papriku, cesnak a údenú papriku a opekaj 3 minúty, kým zelenina trochu nezmäkne.
steps.en: Add the onion, pepper, garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 3 minutes until the vegetables soften a little.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky a 150 ml vody, osoľ, vyškrab dno a priveď do varu. Prikry, zníž oheň a nechaj 20 minút mierne dusiť.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes and 150 ml of water, season with the salt, scrape the bottom of the pan and bring to the boil. Cover, lower the heat and simmer gently for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľu a var odokryté ešte 5 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne a kura nie je vnútri prepečené (75 °C).
steps.en: Add the beans and simmer uncovered for another 5 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through (75 °C).

steps.sk: Posyp nasekanou petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj s chlebom. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve with bread. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and can be frozen.

title.sk: Cottage pie – mäso pod zemiakovou kašou

description.sk: Britská zapekaná klasika: hovädzie so zeleninou pod chrumkavou kašou.
description.en: A British bake: beef and vegetables under a crispy mash.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na rovnako veľké kusy a vlož do hrnca so studenou osolenou vodou. Priveď do varu a var asi 20 minút, kým sa nedajú ľahko prepichnúť nožom.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut them into even pieces and put them in a pan of cold salted water. Bring to the boil and cook for about 20 minutes until easily pierced with a knife.

steps.sk: Medzitým cibuľu a mrkvu nakrájaj na drobné kocky. Vo veľkej panvici zohrej olej na strednom ohni a zeleninu opekaj 5 minút, kým nezmäkne. Zvýš oheň, pridaj mäso a varechou ho rozbíjaj; opekaj asi 6 minút, kým nie je bez ružovej farby a nezačne hnednúť.
steps.en: Meanwhile dice the onion and carrots finely. Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the vegetables for 5 minutes until soft. Turn up the heat, add the beef and break it up with a wooden spoon; cook for about 6 minutes until no pink remains and it starts to brown.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj múku a pretlak a minútu opekaj. Prilej 300 ml horúcej vody s rozpusteným bujónom, pridaj tymian, polovicu soli a korenie a mierne var 15 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne. Na konci vmiešaj hrášok.
steps.en: Stir in the flour and tomato paste and cook for a minute. Pour in 300 ml of hot water with the stock cube dissolved in it, add the thyme, half the salt and the pepper and simmer gently for 15 minutes until the sauce thickens. Stir in the peas at the end.

steps.sk: Zemiaky sceď, nechaj ich minútu odpariť a roztlač s maslom, teplým mliekom a zvyšnou soľou na hladkú kašu. Studené mlieko by kašu ochladilo a zlepilo.
steps.en: Drain the potatoes, let them steam dry for a minute and mash them with the butter, warm milk and remaining salt until smooth. Cold milk would cool the mash and make it gluey.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C (horný a spodný ohrev). Mäsovú zmes daj do zapekacej misy (asi 25 × 20 cm), navrch lyžicou poukladaj kašu a opatrne ju rozotri až k okrajom, aby mäso uzavrela. Vidličkou urob na povrchu ryhy – zapečú sa do chrumkava – a posyp nastrúhaným čedarom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (conventional). Spoon the meat into a baking dish (about 25 × 20 cm), dollop the mash on top and spread it carefully to the edges to seal in the filling. Rough up the surface with a fork – the ridges bake crisp – and sprinkle with the grated cheddar.

steps.sk: Peč 25 minút, kým povrch nie je zlatohnedý a na okrajoch nebublá omáčka. Pred podávaním nechaj 5 minút odpočinúť.
steps.en: Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden brown and the sauce bubbles at the edges. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

steps.sk: Zvyšok vydrží 4 dni v chladničke a 3 mesiace v mrazničke. Zamraziť sa dá aj neupečený; po rozmrazení ho peč o 10 minút dlhšie.
steps.en: Leftovers keep for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer. You can also freeze it unbaked; after thawing, bake it 10 minutes longer.

title.sk: Fazuľa v paradajkovej omáčke na toaste

description.sk: Britské študentské raňajky aj večera – domáca a lacná.
description.en: A British student breakfast or supper, homemade and cheap.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno. V malom hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu opekaj 3 minúty, kým nezmäkne a nezosklovatie – nemá zhnednúť.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion. Heat the oil in a small pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes until soft and translucent – it should not brown.

steps.sk: Pridaj passatu, údenú papriku, cukor, ocot a soľ, premiešaj a mierne var 5 minút, kým omáčka trochu nezhustne. Ochutnaj – má byť jemne sladko-kyslá.
steps.en: Add the passata, smoked paprika, sugar, vinegar and salt, stir and simmer gently for 5 minutes until slightly thickened. Taste – it should be mildly sweet and sour.

steps.sk: Fazuľu sceď, prepláchni a pridaj do omáčky. Povar ešte 3 minúty, aby sa prehriala a nasala chuť; niekoľko fazúľ roztlač varechou, omáčka bude krémovejšia.
steps.en: Drain and rinse the beans and add them to the sauce. Simmer for 3 minutes more so they heat through and take on the flavour; crush a few with the spoon for a creamier sauce.

steps.sk: Medzitým opeč chlieb v hriankovači alebo na suchej panvici dozlatista. Ak chceš syr, nastrúhaj čedar.
steps.en: Meanwhile toast the bread in a toaster or dry frying pan until golden. If you want cheese, grate the cheddar.

steps.sk: Toasty polož na taniere, navrch nalej horúcu fazuľu a podľa chuti posyp čedarom, ktorý sa na nej roztopí. Podávaj hneď, kým je toast chrumkavý.
steps.en: Put the toast on plates, spoon the hot beans over it and sprinkle with the cheddar if using, letting it melt. Serve at once while the toast is crisp.
